name: PhotoModel sources
description: Linux-safe state and logic behind Photo's window, each menu, toolbar and palette action also a SuiteKernel catalog command (PhotoCommandCatalog: ids, availability from today's help, menu labels; PhotoMenuState, the spec each menu item is built from, with the menu's window, sheet, text focus and pasteboard), PhotoHeadless (the window-less document the CLI and real jobs drive: open .ora, PNG and JPEG, save .ora, export PNG or JPEG at an optional long side, the catalog lifted onto it) over CoreRasterImageCodec (PNG and JPEG through creative-core, with a small own 8-bit PNG reader and writer until core's lands):PhotoWorkspace (the open image's size and name, the layer stack with each layer's offset and its pixels as copy-on-write CoreRaster tiles (TiledPixels), so an edit copies only the tiles it touches, the selected layer, tool, and the brush's and eraser's own tool options with the brush cursor diameter, the marquee selection and pending crop), the tools' drags (brush and eraser strokes and clone dabs sampled through SuiteKernel's stroke model, StrokeSmoother and DabSpacer, with each tool's options kept as kernel BrushSettings and a list of BrushPresets; marquee, crop, move, and the Clone and Heal tools' Option-click to sample and drag to clone or heal), the clone stamp (a sampled source and a stroke that copies from it at a fixed offset onto the selected layer, and heal, the same stroke with each dab shifted to the tone where it lands), selection edits and crop, Image Size, Rotate and Straighten (worked out off the main actor, committed unless the image changed), the undo history (the tiles an edit changed, layer lists and whole stacks, read as a list of named steps from "New Image" or "Open" with a jump to any step), the tile-parallel renderer with damage tracking (a full frame as the reference, or the live canvas's update: only the damaged tiles, premultiplied), and on the GPU the live route (adjustments and adjustment layers as CoreRender tone programs over a cached composite of the pixel layers, written to the canvas texture in one pass) and the adjustments it applies (exposure, levels, curves, hue/saturation, blur) with the curve editor's samples and histogram, opening and exporting through the PhotoImageCodec protocol, the adjustment settings and logarithmic gamma track (with the Gamma field's commit, a no-op for the value it shows), what the inspector shows (with the image header lines and the viewer status size text), and when each Layer menu item can run (with Bring Forward and Send Backward, one place up or down the stack, and Select Layer Above and Below), the layer stack's reorder, arrange, duplicate and show/hide run on SuiteKernel's LayerTree (a single-level tree of PhotoLayer payloads, bottom first, projected to and from the top-first list), Place (the workspace as SuiteKernel's PlacedImageTarget, with File > Place…'s help and the drop point in document pixels, each file run as place.image), and the live edit services (the clipboard and layer merging, through the renderer's per-layer composite) behind Cut, Copy and Paste of pixels (a pasted layer, or a new image with none open) and Duplicate Layer, Merge Down and Flatten Image, each one named undo step with its reason when it can't run, and the eyedropper as SuiteKernel's SampleTarget (PhotoSample+Kernel: its sample size, the composite's colour at a point, a pick into the brush colour as tool state), and Free Transform, the layer flips and Canvas Size as SuiteKernel's TransformTarget (PhotoTransform+Kernel: the draft's or layer's box, begin, commit and cancel).
